title: Social post card quote settle
summary: One white social-post card on a blue diagonal gradient: avatar and footer land first, name and handle rise, the two-line quote sweeps in word by word within 1 s, then the card holds still and fades out. Social proof in one calm beat.
use_when: Sharing one user quote or public post as social proof
A square feed clip that must read as a real platform post
A short insert between feature shots in a longer launch film
Silent autoplay where one sentence carries the message

look.type_style: neutral grotesk, sentence case, normal tracking; quote regular ~4 % H, name bold ~2.7 % H, handle and footer regular grey ~2.4 % H, footer source in accent blue

structure.shot: empty blue gradient, then a white rounded post card centred: photo avatar, name with verified badge, handle, 2-line quote, grey meta footer
structure.motion: card appears between f0 and f8 at its final place and size (entrance type not measurable, ±0.25 s); avatar and footer already set at f8; handle and name rise from a clip mask f8-f15 (springs.ui, overshoot not measurable); quote word-reveal left to right f15-f30, easings.outQuint per word (±0.25 s); all settled by f30

structure.shot: the full post card holds: quote of 2 lines, about 12 words plus one emoji, names the user's reaction
structure.motion: full hold 112 fr, nothing moves (motion diff 0.0 for 1-4 s)

structure.shot: card fades to transparent and shrinks slightly, leaving the empty gradient (same as frame 0)
structure.motion: card opacity 1 to 0 and scale 1.00 to ~0.94 over 5 fr (f142-f147), easings.inExpo; empty gradient holds f147-f150

params.brand: any brand.json: bg gradient from accent, card surface, fg, muted grey, accent for the badge and footer link
params.content.quote: the post text, 1-3 lines, about 12-20 words; an emoji at the end is fine
params.content.name: display name of the person quoted
params.content.avatar: square photo of the person (with consent); falls back to initials
params.content.verified: show the badge after the name (default true)
params.content.meta: footer: time, date and the posting client
params.aspect: 1:1 (reference) | 4:5 | 9:16 | 16:9; card width ~82 % of frame width at 1:1
params.timing.hold: frames the settled card holds (default 112 at 30 fps)
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); all timing scales with it

notes: Studied from 4 fps sheets only (no 30 fps strips): the entrance (f0-f30) and the exit (f142-f147) are at ±0.25 s resolution. Card geometry from kf-001.50: x 104-1083 of 1188 (82 % W), y 368-820 (38 % H), corner radius ~2 % W, soft blue-tinted drop shadow below. Background is a diagonal gradient, lighter top-left (#39A9E8) to darker bottom-right (#1C7FBB). The last frame equals the first (empty gradient), so the clip loops. Text colour near-black was not captured by palettegen (too few pixels). sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent). Proposed term: post-card (platform-accurate social post rebuilt as UI), not in vocabulary. The hint card-grid does not apply: a single card, no cascade.
